item.description:
Quick Chat stays open while you visit Finder or the Dock to fetch a picture. Drag its empty background to move it; it remembers its place on each display. Closing keeps your message, pictures and chat choices.
Drop files or pictures anywhere on the box, or onto Séance's crystal ball in the menu bar. On a MacBook, click the notch to open Quick Chat and click away to tuck it back, with a small line when a message is waiting. On other displays, dragging a file near the top middle reveals a drop target. Pictures now have thumbnails in Quick Chat and New Chat.
Settings → General controls click-away, notch click/hover and screen-top drops. Hover opening starts off.
